familiar.desc: A familiar who is immune to dying or perishing through conventional means.

familiar.name: Regenerator
familiar.desc: A familiar who has formidable regenerative abilities.

familiar.name: Healer
familiar.desc: A familiar who has healing abilities or the capability to provide medical aid to others.

familiar.name: Breeding
familiar.desc: A familiar who has advanced reproductive abilities.

familiar.name: Shapeshifter
familiar.desc: A familiar who can alter and change their physical form.
